parameters.value: Portable Digital Body Mass Index Machine

parameters.parameter: Measures Body Mass Index with reference to weight, height and age of the person under check
Light weight and portable in a small box or single bag
User friendly and easy to operate
Adjustable horizontal piece hosting the sensor and display
Alarm for over load and malfunctioning
Charging adapter and Battery pack provided
Supply of free spare parts under warranty
Auto setting to 0 decimal 00 once the machine is switched on or when no external weight has been put on
Material of vertical column hosting the sensor and display unit
Simultaneous display of pre- programmed matrix of BMI, over weight and under weight of person being checked
Suitable AC power built-in adaptor (BIS-CRS for safety) to be provided
All the main parts and accessories are Individually bubble wrapped and packed in a strong box to avoid transit damage
Compliance to Medical Device Rules (MDR) 2017 as amended till date
Availability of valid drug license/registration for the product issued from the competent authority defined under Drugs and Cosmetic Act 1940 and Rules made there under as amended till date
Availability of Test Report for product as per Medical Device Rules (MDR) 2017 as amended till date
Submission of all necessary certifications, licenses and test reports to the buyer at the time of bid submission and/or along with supplies as per buyer requirement
Type Test Cerificate including Environmental conditions from Regional Reference and Standard Laboratory (RRSL)
Model approval certificate for each model from Director (Legal Metrology) available
Calibration from concerned weights and measurement controllerate to be furnished at the time of supplies
Availability of toll free facility for technical support maintened by OEM or authorized agencies
User/Technical/Maintenance manuals to be supplied in English in hard and soft copy
Details of equipments and procedures required for local calibration and routine maintenance to be supplied and advanced maintenance task documentation also to be furnished
Installation and Demonstration of equipment and training to be provided after completing supplies before acceptance
Principal Manufacturer must have direct Presence/approved service center In India
